values: Use this form to record the outcome of testing the public GESS website and Content Studio admin workspace.
Hero content, GESS logo, images, and calls to action load correctly.
Every navbar link opens the intended public page without a 404 error.
Event pages and event media are visible and easy to browse.
Documents list and linked PDF files open correctly.
Achievement images display in full without broken links or unwanted cropping.
Officers page, profile carousel, and PDF viewer load and remain usable.
Uniform or merchandise gallery images display correctly.
Contact form submits successfully and Facebook link opens the intended page.
Website remains readable and usable on desktop, tablet, and mobile screen sizes.
Keyboard navigation, labels, contrast, and visible focus states work as expected.
Authorized administrator can sign in and unauthorized access remains blocked.
Dashboard metrics, navigation, and command search display correctly.
Admin can create, edit, publish, and delete announcements; public updates appear.
Admin can create, edit, publish, and delete articles; formatting renders correctly.
Events, documents, achievements, officers, and merch can be managed successfully.
Supported images and PDFs upload and are shown at the correct public URL.
Contact submissions reach the private inbox and remain unavailable to public visitors.
Only authenticated administrators can view or change protected Content Studio data.

Overall testing outcome / recommendation:

☐ Ready for release
☐ Ready with minor fixes
☐ Needs further testing
